# edgekey.net
> EdgeKey provides DNS, CDN, and edge security services for web performance, delivery, and protection.

EdgeKey appears to be associated with edge infrastructure and delivery services. This llms.txt highlights the main public-facing areas likely most useful to language models, prioritizing product, support, and technical resources where available.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://edgekey.net/): Main entry point for EdgeKey services and site navigation.
- [About](https://edgekey.net/about): Overview of the company, mission, and service focus.
- [Contact](https://edgekey.net/contact): Contact information and inquiry options for customers and partners.
- [Support](https://edgekey.net/support): Customer support entry point for service help and issue resolution.

## Products
- [CDN Services](https://edgekey.net/cdn): Content delivery capabilities for accelerating web and media traffic.
- [DNS Services](https://edgekey.net/dns): Managed DNS offerings for resilient and performant domain resolution.
- [Security](https://edgekey.net/security): Edge security protections including traffic filtering and threat mitigation.
- [Performance](https://edgekey.net/performance): Site and application optimization services delivered at the edge.

## Solutions
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://edgekey.net/solutions/enterprise): Edge delivery and security solutions for large-scale organizations.
- [Media Delivery](https://edgekey.net/solutions/media): Streaming and media acceleration use cases for distributed delivery.
- [Ecommerce](https://edgekey.net/solutions/ecommerce): Performance and protection solutions for online storefronts.
- [Application Delivery](https://edgekey.net/solutions/application-delivery): Edge services for modern web and application traffic.
